llm.summary: This is a legacy persona helper with read-only local metadata scripts, but its unpinned install command should be treated cautiously.

dimensions.detail: Local code access is proportionate: scripts read only packaged files under the artifact and do not access credentials, broad local data, network resources, or user profiles.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md tells users to run `npx clawhub@latest install deepseekoracle/lygo-champion-council`, which executes a mutable latest package without a pinned version or integrity check.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The persona uses dramatic collapse/executor language, but the main behavior contract explicitly says it is a helper, not a controller, with no coercion or wrongdoing guidance.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No artifact code installs persistence, modifies system configuration, writes files, escalates privileges, or creates background workers; verifier documentation mentions ledgers for a separate tool only.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifact is mostly coherent as a deprecated LYGO persona helper that points to a successor while retaining legacy persona content; the included scripts only read local reference files and print/check metadata.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, prefer the successor skill and use a pinned, verified ClawHub installer instead of the documented `@latest` command. Treat the persona text as advisory framing only, not permission for automatic shutdown, deletion, enforcement, or irreversible actions.
llm.findings:
[TP4] expected: The local scripts support the disclosed verification/hash reference workflow and only read packaged files; the frontmatter deprecation wording is terse but the SKILL body discloses the persona helper and references.
[AE4] expected: Mixed Unicode such as OMNIΣIREN and Δ9 appears to be branding/persona text, with an ASCII champion identifier also present; it is a usability/spoofing caution, not evidence of hidden behavior.
[LP3] expected: No tool scope is declared, but the skill instructions are advisory and the shipped scripts are read-only; there is no evidence of broad or privileged tool use.
[RP1] unexpected: The unpinned `npx clawhub@latest` install instruction is a real supply-chain concern because future installer behavior can change outside this artifact review.
[SDI-1] expected: The package is marked deprecated but also says it is legacy retention, so retained persona content is explainable; users should prefer the successor slug.
[SDI-4] expected: The executor/collapse wording is strong persona framing, but nearby instructions constrain the skill to advisory use and prohibit wrongdoing guidance.
[SQP-2] expected: Irreversible-collapse language is present, but the actionable SKILL guidance frames use around ethical shutdown, rollback, quarantine, archiving, and risk assessment.
[T08] unexpected: The static scan's mutable latest-package concern is supported by the install command and should be addressed by pinning and verifying the installer.
[T09] unexpected: The self-check script validates metadata shape rather than independently verifying content integrity; the current persona_pack.md hash matches canon.json, but the script should not be treated as a full integrity verifier.
